book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, not from any translation

sentences.ar: رجل قاعد بيقرا الجريدة بعد العشا.
sentences.en: A man sat reading the newspaper after supper.
His wife said: look at the lottery numbers.

sentences.ar: قرا الرقم الأول ولقاه بيطابق ورقتها.
sentences.en: He read the first number and found it matched her ticket.

sentences.ar: ما قرا الرقم التاني على طول.
sentences.en: He did not read the second number at once.

sentences.ar: قعد يفكر شو رح يعملوا بالمصاري.
sentences.en: He sat thinking what they would do with the money.
He thought of a house in the country, and travel, and rest.

sentences.ar: وبعدين تذكر إن الورقة باسمها هي.
sentences.en: And then he remembered the ticket was in her name.

sentences.ar: صار يفكر إنها رح تصرف عليهم كلهم.
sentences.en: He began thinking she would spend it on all of them.
And he looked at her sitting in front of him.

sentences.ar: قرا الرقم التاني، وما كان مطابق.
sentences.en: He read the second number, and it did not match.
The two were silent, and the room became small.
